Alex: Quick async standup — SDKs / sample apps / docs
Alex: What I did: merged the samplekit PR for streaming examples (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/412). Updated README snippets.
Alex: Blockers: CI failing on macos wheel build intermittently, see below. Also need one more review on the docs fix.
Alex: Today: triage CI flakes, land docs fix, follow up with infra on M1 runner.

Maya: acked. will review docs PR later today :+1:
Maya: FYI opened a tiny PR to change the quickstart env var names — pinging @Olivia for docs impact https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900

Sam: CI note — reproducer:
Sam: ```
docker buildx bake --set *.target=linux/amd64
pytest tests/sample_integration.py::test_streaming -k 'small' -q
```
Sam: Flake seems to be an occasional socket timeout in the test harness (connection reset). I can add a retry wrapper but want to see infra metrics first.

Olivia: I'll take the docs PR, thanks Maya. Also noticed a missing code example for `client.stream_chat` in the quickstart, will add.
Olivia: ETA EOD for review. Can someone add the sample app env var mapping in the onboarding page? it's `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> `RW_API_KEY`

Rui: quick question — samplekit CI uses `pytest-xdist` shards, is that turned on for macos? last time we disabled it for M1.

docs-bot: [automation] deployed docs preview for PR #900: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference/docs/900

Alex: @Rui good catch — I think macos is single-threaded in CI, but the builder caches might be different. @Sam please add the exact failing job name so I can tag infra.

Sam: failing job: `macos-latest / wheel-macos-build` — added logs to the PR.
Sam: adding a short retry around the socket call in test to reduce noise.

Maya: quick heads-up: I'm OOO tomorrow morning, but will be reachable on Slack for urgent reviews.

Olivia: added code snippet and pushed to PR, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900/files

Alex: thanks team — will follow up with infra. If anyone lands docs changes, please add a changelog entry under `docs/quickstarts`.
Alex: :thumbsup:
